Roth.exists_roth_approximants_aux✝ {α κ : ℝ} (hα : Irrational α) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hinf : (Roth.approxSet α κ).Infinite)
  (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (A : ℝ) :
  ∃ h q r,
    (∀ (j : Fin m), (h j, q j) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin m), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin m), 1 < q j) ∧
          (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < r j) ∧
            3 ≤ r (Fin.rev 0) ∧
              (∀ (i j : Fin m), ↑i + 1 = ↑j → ↑(r j) / δ ≤ ↑(r i)) ∧
                (∀ (j : Fin m), r j ≤ r 0) ∧
                  2 * ↑m + 1 + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + |α|) < δ ^ 2 * Real.log ↑(q 0) ∧
                    (∀ (j : Fin m), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) ∧
                      ∀ (j : Fin m), ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j) < (1 + δ / 10) * (↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0))

private theorem Roth.exists_roth_approximants_aux : ∀ {α κ : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    0 < κ →
      (Roth.approxSet α κ).Infinite →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) [inst : NeZero m] {δ : ℝ},
          0 < δ →
            δ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (A : ℝ),
                ∃ h q r,
                  (∀ (j : Fin m), (h j, q j) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ) ∧
                    (∀ (j : Fin m), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) ∧
                      (∀ (j : Fin m), 1 < q j) ∧
                        (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < r j) ∧
                          3 ≤ r (Fin.rev 0) ∧
                            (∀ (i j : Fin m), ↑i + 1 = ↑j → ↑(r j) / δ ≤ ↑(r i)) ∧
                              (∀ (j : Fin m), r j ≤ r 0) ∧
                                2 * ↑m + 1 + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + |α|) <
                                    δ ^ 2 * Real.log ↑(q 0) ∧
                                  (∀ (j : Fin m), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) ∧
                                    ∀ (j : Fin m),
                                      ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j) < (1 + δ / 10) * (↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0)) :=
fun {α κ} hα hκ hinf m [inst : NeZero m] {δ} hδ0 hδ1 A ↦
  Exists.casesOn
    (Roth.exists_approximants hα hκ hinf m
      ((2 * ↑m + 1 + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + |α|)) / δ ^ 2))
    fun h h_1 ↦
    Exists.casesOn h_1 fun q h_2 ↦
      And.casesOn h_2 fun happ right ↦
        And.casesOn right fun hcop right ↦
          And.casesOn right fun hq1 right ↦
            And.casesOn right fun hL h50 ↦
              Exists.casesOn (Roth.exists_degrees hδ0 hδ1 hq1 fun i j hij ↦ LT.lt.le (h50 i j hij)) fun r h_3 ↦
                And.casesOn h_3 fun hr0 right ↦
                  And.casesOn right fun h31a right ↦
                    And.casesOn right fun h31b right ↦
                      And.casesOn right fun h33 h53 ↦
                        have hranti :=
                          Exists.casesOn (Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne m)) fun m_1 h_4 ↦
                            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun m ↦
                              ∀ [inst : NeZero m] (h : Fin m → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℕ),
                                (∀ (j : Fin m), (h j, q j) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ) →
                                  (∀ (j : Fin m), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
                                    (∀ (j : Fin m), 1 < q j) →
                                      (2 * ↑m + 1 + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + |α|)) / δ ^ 2 <
                                          Real.log ↑(q 0) →
                                        (∀ (i j : Fin m), ↑i + 1 = ↑j → 2 / δ * Real.log ↑(q i) < Real.log ↑(q j)) →
                                          ∀ (r : Fin m → ℕ),
                                            (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < r j) →
                                              (∀ (j : Fin m), 10 / δ < ↑(r j)) →
                                                (∀ (i j : Fin m), ↑i + 1 = ↑j → ↑(r j) / δ < ↑(r i)) →
                                                  (∀ (j : Fin m), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
                                                    (∀ (j : Fin m),
                                                        ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j) <
                                                          (1 + δ / 10) * (↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0))) →
                                                      Antitone r)
                              (fun [NeZero m_1.succ] h q happ hcop hq1 hL h50 r hr0 h31a h31b h33 h53 ↦
                                Fin.antitone_iff_succ_le.mpr fun i ↦
                                  cast Nat.cast_le._simp_1
                                    (LE.le.trans (le_div_self (Nat.cast_nonneg (r i.succ)) hδ0 hδ1)
                                      (LT.lt.le (h31b i.castSucc i.succ rfl))))
                              (Eq.symm h_4) h q happ hcop hq1 hL h50 r hr0 h31a h31b h33 h53;
                        Exists.intro h
                          (Exists.intro q
                            (Exists.intro r
                              ⟨happ,
                                ⟨hcop,
                                  ⟨hq1,
                                    ⟨hr0,
                                      ⟨cast Nat.cast_le._simp_1
                                          (LE.le.trans
                                            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true
                                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 3))
                                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 10)) (Eq.refl true))
                                            (LE.le.trans
                                              (le_div_self
                                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true
                                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
                                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 10)) (Eq.refl true))
                                                hδ0 hδ1)
                                              (LT.lt.le (h31a (Fin.rev 0))))),
                                        ⟨fun i j hij ↦ LT.lt.le (h31b i j hij),
                                          ⟨fun j ↦ hranti (Fin.zero_le j),
                                            ⟨(div_lt_iff₀' (pow_pos hδ0 2)).mp hL, ⟨h33, h53⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩))

  Irrational α →
    0 < κ →
      (Roth.approxSet α κ).Infinite →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) [inst : NeZero m] {δ : ℝ},
          0 < δ →
            δ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (A : ℝ),
                ∃ (h : Fin m → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ),
                  (∀ (j : Fin m), (h j, q j) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ) ∧
                    (∀ (j : Fin m), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) ∧
                      (∀ (j : Fin m), 1 < q j) ∧
                        (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < r j) ∧
                          3 ≤ r (Fin.rev 0) ∧
                            (∀ (i j : Fin m), ↑i + 1 = ↑j → ↑(r j) / δ ≤ ↑(r i)) ∧
                              (∀ (j : Fin m), r j ≤ r 0) ∧
                                2 * ↑m + 1 + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + |α|) <
                                    δ ^ 2 * Real.log ↑(q 0) ∧
                                  (∀ (j : Fin m), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) ∧
                                    ∀ (j : Fin m), ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j) < (1 + δ / 10) * (↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0))
